finding: opening a plain CLI draft in 剪映 and letting it save rewrites draft_content.json into a Base64 envelope. auto-canary-review was plain before I opened it for the 4.3 playback observation and is encrypted now (5308 bytes)
consequences: plan_resource_lint --draft and export_reconciliation answer draft_content_encrypted for that copy
the provenance of the copy is still fine, but its content can no longer be diffed against what the CLI wrote

replacement_prepared.source: auto-canary (still plain, fps 30, video + text track)

instruction_for_the_next_export: open auto-canary-export (not auto-canary-review) in 剪映, press 导出, keep the default path; then python tools/export_reconciliation.py --draft <that dir> finds the newest file and reconciles it
not_proven: whether the editor encrypts on every save or only after a delay - one observation
whether an encrypted draft can be decrypted by any supported path; none was attempted
